presentation.label: CONTROL IN ACTIONS
presentation.summary: An ACTION mode for EXP/CV IN 1 and 2: a gate or footswitch holds or toggles the MUTE screen or live recording, or holds or latches FILL.
presentation.overview: Stock's CONTROL INPUT menus get a fourth MODE, ACTION. Pick what the input does in the ACTION row: MUTE HLD shows the MUTE screen while the input is high and goes back to the mode you were in when it drops, MUTE TGL opens and closes it, REC HLD records live while the input is high, REC TGL turns live recording on and off, FILL HLD holds FILL, FILL LAT latches and unlatches it. Live recording starts a stopped sequencer and never stops it. A 0 to 5 V gate works as it is; for a footswitch, ACTION LEARN reads its two levels. Bars beside the menu show the input against the learned levels and whether it counts as pressed. Each jack has its own MODE, so one can switch while the other still plays the kit's CV or expression macro.
highlights: Hands-free mutes with both hands on the pads
Set up in stock's own CONTROL INPUT menus, saved with them
Works with a 0 to 5 V gate or a footswitch
usage: Plug a footswitch or a 0 to 5 V gate into EXP/CV IN 1, then open GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 and turn MODE past EXPR to ACTION.
Choose ACTION LEARN, press the switch a few times and press YES. If the bars' right-hand line drops with your foot off the switch, choose REVERSE DIRECTION.
Set the ACTION row to MUTE HLD, leave the menu and play: hold the switch and tap pads to mute them, let go to go back to playing.
Set it to REC TGL: a tap starts live recording, even from stop, and the next tap leaves it while the pattern plays on.

steps: Connect a gate or footswitch to EXP/CV IN 1 or 2.
Open GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 (or 2) and set MODE to ACTION.
Set ACTION to MUTE HLD, MUTE TGL, REC HLD, REC TGL, FILL HLD or FILL LAT.
For a footswitch, run ACTION LEARN, press it a few times and YES; if the bars' line drops with your foot off it, set REVERSE DIRECTION.

limitations: Stay within the jack's -5 V to +5 V.
The input is read about 20 times a second, so an action can come up to about 50 ms after it.
A jack in ACTION mode plays no CONTROL IN MOD macro. Without the module, a unit left in ACTION mode reads that jack as nothing.

claims: ui:GLOBAL > CONTROL > CONTROL INPUT 1 and 2: MODE ACTION and its ACTION list
input:EXP/CV IN 1 and 2 in ACTION mode

load.conditions: UI only: two readings each UI tick, never in the audio path.

tests.summary: Author's unit reports on an Analog Rytm MKII, builds alone: CI06 and CI07 passed every action, ACTION LEARN with YES and NO, REVERSE DIRECTION, EXPRESSION LEARN's NO and a power cycle; CI09 (this package's source, with the ACTION LEARN name and a code review's fixes) passed the bars, both learns' NO and a hold action. rytm-emu on CE02 to CE14, CI08 and CI09. Not run beside other modules.
